item.title: Report Shows Orkney 2025 Island Games Delivered Major Boost and Long Lasting Legacy
item.description: A new report shows the Orkney 2025 Island Games delivered millions to the local economy and left a strong sporting and community legacy, highlighting record attendance, major investment and the remarkable volunteer effort that defined the week.The post Report Shows Orkney 2025 Island Games Delivered Major Boost and Long Lasting Legacy appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: New Poll Puts SNP Out in Front as Labour Falls Behind
item.description: A new IPSOS poll places the SNP clearly ahead ahead of next year’s Holyrood election, with Labour falling sharply and Reform challenging for second place, alongside renewed majority support for independence among Scottish voters.The post New Poll Puts SNP Out in Front as Labour Falls Behind appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Seven Thousand Sign Industry Letter Demanding End to Labour’s Tax on Scotland’s Energy
item.description: Seven thousand workers and industry leaders have urged the UK Government to end Labour’s North Sea tax as job losses rise, highlighting falling revenues, disputed claims over excessive profits and growing concerns about the impact on Scotland’s energy sector. The post Seven Thousand Sign Industry Letter Demanding End to Labour’s Tax on Scotland’s Energy appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Community Art Trail to Launch Dingwall’s 800th Anniversary Celebrations
item.description: Dingwall’s 800th anniversary year will open with a community art trail lighting up homes and businesses across the town, setting the tone for a year of cultural celebrations, historical events and creative activity led by local groups and partners.The post Community Art Trail to Launch Dingwall’s 800th Anniversary Celebrations appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Counterfeit Labubu Dolls and Illicit Tobacco Seized in Moray Raids
item.description: Trading Standards officers in Moray have seized counterfeit Labubu dolls and illicit tobacco products as safety concerns grow ahead of Christmas, with officials warning of choking hazards, poor construction and harmful materials in untested toys.The post Counterfeit Labubu Dolls and Illicit Tobacco Seized in Moray Raids appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Emma Roddick Calls for Clear Timeline on Nairn Bypass as Pressure Grows on A96
item.description: Emma Roddick is urging ministers to publish a clear timeline for the Nairn Bypass, warning that congestion, pollution and future development pressures make it the most urgent section of the A96 and a critical priority for local communities.The post Emma Roddick Calls for Clear Timeline on Nairn Bypass as Pressure Grows on A96 appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Highland Council Unveils New Investment Prospectus to Drive Regional Growth
item.description: Highland Council has launched a major investment prospectus outlining billions in planned public and private projects, aiming to attract new investors, strengthen key sectors and support long term growth across communities from housing and energy to digital and transport.The post Highland Council Unveils New Investment Prospectus to Drive Regional Growth appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Major Traffic Measures Announced Ahead of A9 Dualling Works
item.description: A9 drivers face major traffic changes from January as a long term 40mph restriction and phased measures prepare the route for dualling works between Tay Crossing and Ballinluig, with officials urging caution and extra journey time during construction.The post Major Traffic Measures Announced Ahead of A9 Dualling Works appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Highland Council Waits for New Visitor Levy Legislation Before Next Steps
item.description: Highland Council will wait for new legislation before deciding how a Visitor Levy might be designed, as councillors assess future charging models, local impacts and the potential to direct levy income toward projects that support communities and enhance visitor experiences.The post Highland Council Waits for New Visitor Levy Legislation Before Next Steps appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Jamie Stone Calls for Protection of Seasonal Work as Employment Rights Bill Advances
item.description: Jamie Stone is urging ministers to consult businesses that depend on seasonal labour as employment reforms progress, warning that new rules on flexible working and guaranteed hours could unintentionally harm rural industries across Caithness, Sutherland and Easter Ross.The post Jamie Stone Calls for Protection of Seasonal Work as Employment Rights Bill Advances appeared first on The Highland Times.
